films.name: Lemur
markers: black-and-white ringed tail longer than the body
fox-like muzzle with a black mask
bright orange-gold staring eyes
films.note: Generic - interpreted as the ring-tailed lemur, the representative member of the group.

films.name: Monkey
markers: long curling tail as long as the body
grasping hands and feet with opposable thumbs
flat forward-facing face with round eyes
films.note: Generic name - interpreted as a macaque/capuchin-type monkey (tailed, not an ape).

films.name: Boa
markers: saddle-shaped dorsal blotches that redden toward the tail
heavy arrow-shaped head with a dark eye stripe
thick body tapering to a short tail

films.name: Mountain Viper
markers: broad triangular head much wider than the neck
thick stocky body with a zigzag dorsal band
vertical slit pupil

films.name: Gibbon
markers: arms far longer than the legs, reaching the ground
long hook-shaped hands
no tail at all
films.note: An ape, not a monkey - tailless, and the arm span is the dominant proportion.

films.name: Spider Monkey
markers: extremely long spindly limbs
prehensile tail longer than the whole body
small round head with a pot belly
films.note: the hands have no functional thumb - they are hooks

films.name: Gorilla
markers: peaked skull crest over a heavy brow ridge
barrel chest with a wide pot belly
knuckle-walking on folded hands
films.note: arms are markedly longer than the legs, so the shoulders sit higher than the hips
